data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 322.1m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development table, there is a small net adverse movement on prior years of approximately GBP 4.5m (c.1.4% of opening gross reserves) which indicates modest gross strengthening. The Managing Agent narrative, however, reports modest favourable (net) prior year development driven by favourable attritional experience in short-tail classes; this implies that net of reinsurance the movement was favourable while gross development was slightly adverse. Major prior-year events referenced include Hurricane Ian, Australian Floods and Storm Elliot (2022), which materially affected 2022 results; 2023 major events included the Hawaii Wildfires and Hurricane Idalia but these relate to the 2023 year. Overall movements are small relative to the reserve base and driven by attritional experience and portfolio mix changes (including quota-share underwriting of property binders).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross amount was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred claims) because no single gross prior-year movement figure was provided in the notes. The Managing Agent narrative reports modest favourable PRIOR YEAR development on a net basis (improving loss ratio by 1.1pps) - this indicates net (after reinsurance) development differs from the gross movement calculated here. The gross PYD derived from the triangle is +4.5m (adverse); the narrative's favourable statement therefore refers to net of reinsurance. No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' note value was found. Lob-level prior-year movements are not separately quantified in the report and are therefore omitted.
